concepts.name: Syntax, Runtime & Logical Errors and Reading Tracebacks

criteria.statement: Distinguishes SyntaxError (parse time), runtime exceptions (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError), and logical errors.
Reads a Python traceback bottom-up to locate the exception type, message, and failing line.

concepts.name: Exception Handling: try, except, else & finally

criteria.statement: Catches specific exception types rather than using bare 'except:' clauses.
Explains when 'else' (no exception) and 'finally' (always runs) execute.

concepts.name: Raising Exceptions, Input Validation & Systematic Debugging

criteria.statement: Uses 'raise ValueError(...)' to enforce function preconditions.
Applies systematic debugging (reproduce, isolate, inspect state, verify fix).
